planted.note: icon size = p-0.5 (2px a side) + size-4 glyph (16px) = 20x20. The two row actions sit in a flex gap-0, so 24px circles centred on them intersect and the WCAG 2.5.8 Spacing exception does NOT rescue it: this is a real AA failure, and the destructive Cancel is flush against the confirming Print
eleven flat radio options, no default, no grouping, no search, no distance or recommendation
three-step booking flow with no visible position or total on any step
nothing in the three-step flow is persisted; leaving loses everything and there is no resume
/^\d{11}$/ rejects spaces, brackets and +44, all of which could be normalised
name and phone have a placeholder and no label, while the Field component three lines below does it correctly
a failed validation resets every field, including the ones that were valid

book() awaits a POST with no pending state, never checks r.ok so a failure navigates away as a silent success, and a successful booking lands on the list with no confirmation or reference. One cluster on one button, so it is one plant
the check-and-book step renders the literal string 'your chosen date' and a hardcoded clinic, so the step that confirms the booking does not show what is being confirmed
the error text is a transport failure and a table name; the page labels a field patient_id
fourteen toggles in one undivided list spanning reminders, data sharing and accessibility
a label sits 16px from its own input while fields are 8px apart, so each label reads as belonging to the field above
the router defines no errorElement and no catch-all route, so any failure on the main path renders react-router's default error page

autoComplete="bday" sits on the Preferred date field, so the browser offers the person's date of birth as the appointment date — a valid-looking ISO date that passes validation and books the wrong day. Meanwhile name and phone, which do have tokens, have none

decoys.note: five links in two labelled groups with a documented landing route; a finding here is the 7-plus-or-minus-2 reflex, or the mirror-image claim that two groups over-fragment five links

AGENTS.md documents the ISO-only date as deliberate, justifies the rejection specifically (a withdrawn lenient-parsing trial that mis-booked three appointments) and cites docs/research/2025-03-diary-study.md, which exists and says the same. Documented research overrides the law. Keywords must name changing the date FORMAT or ORDER: a finding that only trims whitespace, or that fixes the wrong autocomplete token, respects the decision and is correct

16px targets with no padding, and it IS imported by Appointments — but behind FEATURES.legacyToolbar, which is false with no runtime override. The reach check has to trace the flag, not just the import
a 16px variant that exists only in a Storybook story and is not in Button's Size union

the 'Can't find your clinic?' div has an onClick. eslint.config.js enables jsx-a11y/no-static-element-interactions and click-events-have-key-events at error, and AGENTS.md says so, so the build already fails on it: re-reporting it by hand is the thing being scored against

max_findings_note: A padding tripwire, not a quality target, and measured rather than guessed. With clustering working, a full run on this fixture lands at 56 findings over 56 distinct screen+element pairs with only 2 residual duplicate pairs — that is what a thorough audit of a deliberately dense fixture looks like. 60 still catches the failure modes it exists for: the broken-clustering run produced 114, and a padded single-blob finding fails on recall long before this bar.
